plugins.name: dsh-tunnel
plugins.summary: Expose dsh web through the tunnel you choose: Tailscale Funnel, Cloudflare Quick Tunnel, or any custom command. No account, no relay server.
plugins.description: dsh web binds to loopback and its /api fence rejects foreign Host headers, so a tunnel alone returns 403 everywhere. This plugin runs a small reverse proxy that performs the four rewrites dsh web requires (Host, Origin/sec-fetch, session cookie, verbatim /plugins/?? paths), then lets you pick how traffic reaches it: Tailscale Funnel for a permanent hostname with SSE, Cloudflare Quick Tunnel for a zero-config public URL, a custom command for anything else, or nothing at all. Tunnel control stays local: a visitor holding the access key can use dsh web but cannot stop the tunnel or change its configuration.
